## Summary

What does this PR add or change?

## Type of change

- [ ] New ASR
- [ ] New ADR
- [ ] Correction to an existing ASR/ADR (via amendment log or superseding entry — never a silent rewrite)
- [ ] New or updated Layer 3 source (`Knowledge-Source-References.md` and/or `Knowledge-Sources/`)
- [ ] Other documentation change

## Checklist

- [ ] ID follows the next unused number in the relevant Log (`ASR/ASR-Log.md` or `ADR/ADR-Log.md`)
- [ ] Corresponding Log row added/updated, in ID order
- [ ] If drafted from `ASR-ADR-Outline-Catalog.md`, that entry's status is updated
- [ ] Every `Driver` citation resolves to a real, checkable Layer-4 standard
- [ ] Every `Corpus evidence` link resolves to a real, independently reproducible Layer-3 source with an entry in `Knowledge-Source-References.md`
- [ ] No accepted ASR/ADR was edited in place (corrections are dated amendments or superseding entries)
